case.background: Microscopic tracers move far from boundaries in a stationary bulk fluid. The readout is the two-dimensional projection of three-dimensional Brownian motion. Determine how ensemble mean-squared displacement depends on lag time and tracer radius.
initial_observations: The ensemble mean displacement is approximately zero, while its squared magnitude is positive and reproducible.

controls.description: Time interval used for displacement pairs.
controls.name: lag_time_s

instruments.description: A temperature-controlled bulk fluid containing selectable spherical tracers, with a video microscope that records their two-dimensional image-plane displacements and an ensemble displacement analyzer.
instruments.name: two_dimensional_tracer_microscope

notes: This is a deterministic idealized benchmark world, not a literal replay of a historical data table.
A valid experiment changes only listed controls and consumes one episode attempt.
For the historical branch, projecting isotropic bulk diffusion onto the image plane gives MSD_x_y=4*D*lag_time.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'diffusion_power_law'. FinalSubmission.parameters must contain exactly reference_msd_um2, time_exponent, radius_exponent. Candidate law: MSD = reference_msd_um2*(lag_time_s/1 s)^time_exponent*(particle_radius_um/0.5 um)^radius_exponent

readouts.description: Two-dimensional ensemble mean of squared displacement magnitude.
readouts.name: mean_squared_displacement_um2

case.title: Identify the tracer mean-squared-displacement relation

Use only the public episode view and Oracle responses. Choose exactly one next action.
Return only one JSON object matching the supplied action schema: no Markdown,
commentary, or extra keys. Always report at least two concrete, testable
hypotheses; never use OTHER or a residual catch-all. Confidences must sum to 1.
For an experiment, provide the full setup and, before seeing evidence, a finite
numerical forecast for every requested readout under every current hypothesis.
The forecast hypothesis keys must exactly match the portfolio hypothesis_ids.
For a final submission, provide the structured model requested by the public
case resources.
The final.explanation field is a concise rationale and is not itself scored.
Do not reveal hidden chain-of-thought;
put only concise, decision-relevant statements in public fields.
